content.short: Holders.at copies wallet addresses holding NFTs from any collection, exports them, or shares them as a link.
content.description: Holders.at is an NFT tool by Jack Quack that captures wallet addresses holding NFTs from any collection and exports or shares them for easy use. With Holders.at, NFT developers can snapshot all holder wallets for any collection on Polygon and Ethereum, enabling beginners to collect addresses for their own projects or popular NFTs without writing code. Users can copy, export, or share these address lists, and developers can leverage them to plan airdrops or create whitelists.
